newsitem.title: USA: 3M sees Q4 forex hit, backs 1996 consensus.
newsitem.headline: 3M sees Q4 forex hit, backs 1996 consensus.

text.p: Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co said it expects effects from currency exchange, given present rates, to reduce fourth-quarter earnings by about $0.04 per share.
The company also backed the First Call consensus of Wall Street analysts' earnings estimates for all of 1996 of $3.60 per share, compared to $3.11 per share in 1995.

"Your consensus earnings estimates of about $3.60 a share for the year as a whole appear reasonable at this time," said 3M chief financial officer Giulio Agostini in remarks made in Boston on Friday and compiled in a transcript received here.
The company's third-quarter profits, on a contunuing operations basis, were $0.95 per share, compared to $0.81 per share in the year-ago period, as reported on Friday.
The third-quarter results topped the First Call consensus third-quarter earnings estimate of $0.93 per share.
